briefdescription.para: Phase 5 user_storage_encrypted module lifecycle benchmarks and release gates.

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for encrypted storage lifecycle operations (mount, unmount, key derivation, key rotation) identified as Phase 5 performance-critical paths.

sect2.title: Benchmark families
sect2.para: Measure time to mount encrypted container. Gate threshold: p99 ≤ 500ms
Measure time to unmount encrypted container. Gate threshold: p99 ≤ 300ms
Argon2id KDF with standard parameters. Gate threshold: p99 ≤ 1500ms
Full rotation cycle including Vault interaction. Gate threshold: p99 ≤ 10000ms (10 seconds for all 4 tiers)
Measure mounts/second with 4 concurrent threads. Gate threshold: ≥ 0.5 mounts/second per thread
Measure bytes/second for writing to encrypted container. Multiple file sizes: 1MB, 10MB, 100MB Gate threshold: ≥ 50 MB/s

sect2.title: Hard release gates
sect2.para: All benchmarks use steady_clock for precision and multiple runs (5-10) for variance estimation (p95/p99 reporting).
